name: Rice and grain syrup (brown rice syrup, glucose/malt syrup)

tAs.rationale: Total arsenic in rice/grain syrup is dominated by the rice-derived fraction, and the toxic species (inorganic arsenic) is the binding control at 150 ug/kg (read-across from the EU milled-rice iAs ML). The generic refined-sugar total-arsenic ML (100, MERCOSUR/Paraguay) is deliberately NOT applied here because it is incoherent with the rice-derived inorganic-arsenic load (inorganic <= total by identity, so a 100 total cannot coexist with a 150 inorganic control). Total arsenic is measured as a screen; the inorganic-arsenic ceiling governs.
tAs.reference_method: Total As by ICP-MS as a screen; inorganic As by HPLC-ICP-MS is the binding measurement (150 ug/kg).

other_form.scope: refined white sugar with sulphated ash not more than 0.03%, anhydrous dextrose, and dextrose monohydrate

iAs.label: read-across from the EU 2023/915 non-parboiled milled-rice inorganic-arsenic ML (150 ug/kg): rice/grain syrup arsenic derives from the rice, and this rice-grain value is stricter and more source-appropriate than the generic sugar iAs (Israel 500). Infant-destined rice syrup escalates to the infant-rice iAs cell (100).

MeHg.rationale: No methylation pathway and no mercury source in a grain syrup. Total mercury is governed (50, Vietnam).

Ni.rationale: No sovereign nickel ML exists for rice/grain syrup, but rice and cereal grains accumulate nickel (EU regulates husked-rice Ni at 2000), so a source pathway exists. Held under a reflex screen rather than declared not-material.
Ni.reference_method: Total nickel by ICP-MS on each lot; monitored under ALARA against the tightest available food nickel context.

Cr.rationale: No sovereign total-chromium ML exists for rice/grain syrup; the only food chromium MLs in the register are dairy. Rebuttable and audited each build.
Cr.reference_method: Total Cr by ICP-MS screen; reflex Cr(VI) speciation on any total-Cr exceedance.

Cr-VI.rationale: Hexavalent chromium is never a panel number for a food; it is the reflex-speciation species. Any total-chromium exceedance is speciated, and any quantifiable Cr(VI) fails.
Cr-VI.reference_method: IC-ICP-MS Cr(VI) speciation (EPA 3060A + EPA 6800 / EN 15192) on any total-Cr exceedance.

Sn.rationale: Tin migrates only from tinplate cans; these syrups are sold in glass/plastic, not tinplate. No non-canned tin pathway exists.

Al.rationale: No sovereign aluminium ML exists for rice/grain syrup and no aluminium pathway operates. Rebuttable and audited each build.

method: HMTc Method v2.0 (government-limit default; face value, no reconstitution; read-across / control / not-material for unregulated cells; no occurrence percentiles)
lineage_note: Rice and grain syrups are treated as sugars for Pb/Cd/tAs/tHg (strictest sovereign sugar ML). Inorganic arsenic is the load-bearing cell: brown rice syrup is a documented iAs vector (it has been used as a sweetener in infant and toddler foods), and the arsenic derives from the rice, so the cell is a disclosed read-across from the EU non-parboiled milled-rice iAs ML (150) — stricter than the generic sugar iAs (Israel 500) and source-appropriate. Rice/grain syrup DESTINED FOR infant or young-child food falls under the stricter infant-rice iAs cell (100, EU/US/UK/CA) and must be certified there instead.
